participation.context: Spoke the age, the house, the banishment and the comparison, alone.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You spoke the four passages and stopped. You did not say the age to any person. You had heard of the trumpets. You did not go toward them.

title: Said the age to the grass and revised the sentence

description: St George, and the quire already in

participation.context: Read "St George" and left the quire unpriced.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You looked at the almanac and at the paper. You did not enter a sum.

title: Saw the quire of paper

participation.context: Wrote the revision and marked the extra line foul.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You kept the sentence you had spoken, and you put one foul line under it, marked not the book.

title: Wrote the revision and labelled one foul line

participation.context: Wrote the line, left the name blank, and stayed in.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You finished Mowbray's line, the one he will carry on Friday, and you did not go to the Theatre.

title: Wrote Mowbray's farewell at the desk
